fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects attempts to force stop the ufw using ufw-init
fields.name: Ufw Force Stop Using Ufw-Init
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "-ufw-init" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "force-stop") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "ufw" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "disable")))
